status: Decision-ready scenarios, not evidence that a particular stack reaches 10x. Combine with seal-cap.json; null means unknown, not zero. Numerical exploratory endpoints are not credible intervals.

sources.deuterated_ald: Guerra-Nunez et al., Chem Mater 29 (2017) 8690-8703, https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.chemmater.7b02759: D2O tracer for ALD alumina; source metadata https://sonar.ch/global/documents/274995, indexed abstract describes D2O use at 80-220 C. No as-deposited isotope fraction is assumed to survive beam exposure.
sources.ald_pdovercoat: Aireddy et al., ACS Appl Mater Interfaces 14 (2022) 24290-24298, https://doi.org/10.1021/acsami.2c02132, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9164194/: 20-cycle 3-4 nm amorphous alumina on supported Pd nanoparticles blocked CO but H2 access and H-D exchange remained; geometry and chemistry differ from 0.1-2 nm on Pd foil.
sources.pd_growth: Zou et al., RSC Adv 11 (2021) 22773, https://doi.org/10.1039/D1RA03942C, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9034295/: on sapphire Pd ALD was process-sensitive; 22 nm film coalesced at 200 C and island-like at 220 C. Neither is 1 nm Pd on alumina.
sources.la_support: https://doi.org/10.1021/acscatal.2c04920; indexed abstract/title: hydrogen transfer on O(-La) sites adjacent to Pd on La-modified alumina; not a measured recombination barrier for isolated La2O3 on Pd foil.
sources.bzy_bulk: Tao and Irvine, J Solid State Chem 180 (2007) 3493-3503, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jssc.2007.09.027, author abstract https://research-portal.st-andrews.ac.uk/en/publications/conductivity-studies-of-dense-yttrium-doped-bazrosub3sub-sintered/: 1 wt% ZnO-added Ba0.97Zr0.77Y0.19Zn0.04O3-delta, tetragonal a=5.9787 A c=4.2345 A, total conductivity 1e-3 S/cm above 600 C. This is not pure BZY20, not 300 K, not deuterium conductivity.
sources.bzy_ald: Park et al., Thin Solid Films 539 (2013) 166-169, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tsf.2013.05.092, indexed abstract describes ALD Y:BaZrO3 and cation nonstoichiometry/crystallinity effects; not proof of 2-20 nm on Pd under beam.

initial_D_atomic_fraction.denominator: n_D/(n_D+n_Al_or_Er+n_O); hydrogen impurity ignored in this scenario; for mixed H include H in denominator
initial_D_atomic_fraction.status: requested initial design range, not established under vacuum or beam

conversion.formula: for host M2O3 with fixed host formula density nF: nM=2*nF; n_host=5*nF; nD=5*nF*x/(1-x); D/M=(5/2)*x/(1-x)
conversion.assumption: add D at fixed host number density, not replacement of oxygen or constant total atom density; update mass density and stopping for D; nonstoichiometry changes conversion

retention_fraction.status: initial-to-end exploratory extremes; do not identify instantaneous implantation with retained ALD-derived D

rows.transport_and_erosion: Use seal/cap corresponding oxide perm, coverage, sputter and loss scenarios; distinguish bound hydroxyl from mobile D, neither Eads nor mobility known. Evolve n_D under vacuum/beam if kinetics provided, else report frozen initial and explicit lost-D endpoint.
rows.consumer: forward depth n_D and constituent stopping plus transport history
rows.decision_effect: Direct oxide target density can reverse low-energy thick-seal penalty; the 0-100% survival and atom-fraction denominator can dominate whether a 10x enhancement persists.

rows.chemistry: surface adsorption/recombination only; no electronic-screening increment

surface_values.source: g5_recomb when qualified; no direct material-specific source extracted

provisional_scan.status: pass4 almost-sealed scenario to clean-Pd baseline, not BaO measurements; no Ea inferred

rows.consumer: outer boundary only; separately account actual oxide stopping/coverage when non-negligible
rows.decision_effect: Surface loss changes near-surface D and time evolution; promoter's sign is unknown.

rows.chemistry: surface adsorption/recombination only; no electronic-screening increment

surface_values.source: g5_recomb when qualified; no direct SrO/Pd D values extracted

provisional_scan.status: pass4 almost-sealed scenario to clean-Pd baseline, not SrO measurements; no Ea inferred

rows.decision_effect: Rate sign and surface condition could change yield and lifetime ranking.

rows.chemistry: surface adsorption/recombination only; no electronic-screening increment

surface_values.source: g5_recomb when qualified; La-modified alumina catalyst transfer is qualitative analogy only

provisional_scan.status: pass4 almost-sealed scenario to clean-Pd baseline, not La2O3 measurements; no Ea inferred

rows.decision_effect: Support-mediated transfer is not a demonstrated change in recombination under deuteron beam.

density.status: exploratory dense bulk proxy from Zn-doped tetragonal unit cell V=151.36 A3 with two ABO3 units per cell, mapped to Zn-free BZY20 formula mass 274.48 g/mol; not measured film density

hydration.status: ideal charge-neutral BZY20 vacancy model: 0.1 oxygen vacancy/formula in dry material, one D2O fills one vacancy and adds two D; full hydration or no other compensation is not a measurement; hydrated state adds 0.1 O per formula; distinguish H from D

conductivity.status: reported total H ceramic conductivity with Zn in source; no H-to-D isotope factor or extrapolation to ~300 K assumed
conductivity.reason: no mobility, chemical diffusivity, isotope and temperature-resolved values for ALD films extracted; sigma contains carrier density and cannot be used as D diffusivity without a valid constitutive relation

boundary_models.back: electrolyte | BZY | Pd: treat electrochemical supply and chemical-potential continuity/interface resistance; no claim that 2-20 nm increases loading without kinetics
boundary_models.front: Pd | BZY | vacuum: give BZY its own nD, stopping, D outflux and sputter; do not count front D as back flux or double count surface sheet

permeability.status: exploratory order-of-magnitude surrogate only; not BZY measurement

sputter.status: exploratory oxide surrogate; heavy Ba/Zr species make energy-dependent errors possible

rows.decision_effect: room-temperature grain boundary resistance, D hydration, isotope mobility, ion implantation and finite-time interface conductance decide whether film helps feed or blocks it; surface film also absorbs beam and erodes.

rows.stack: start at beam-facing top, alternate actual Pd and oxide layers, terminate at actual substrate; explicitly evaluate stopping and sputter evolution as top layer recedes

interfaces.coverage_status: exploratory end members independently for Pd and oxide; area-weighted columns assume independent vertical columns, not lateral percolation
interfaces.trap_status: exploratory 0 to approximately one close-packed Pd atomic surface density, not measured interface coverage or new adsorption energy
interfaces.trap_profile: represent sheet as separate interface areal inventory or distribute once over a specified resolved thickness; never add it again as outer nads
interfaces.resistance: baseline oxide permeance/thickness in series; interface resistance unknown; connected pinholes create parallel channels, not one uniform resistor

rows.diffusion: use actual Pd transport model and each oxide proxy; no independent interface equilibration rate established
rows.sputter: topmost actual layer yield and inventory must switch with erosion; use pass4 Pd and oxide proxy tables with specified uncertainties, not single bulk average
rows.decision_effect: whether 1 nm Pd islands coalesce and whether 0.2 nm oxide is continuous or penetrated determines traps, actual D connectivity, and lifetime; interfaces can either short or block the feed.
